tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: List all retail chains available in the ShelfAtlas catalog.

tools.name: get_stores
tools.description: List stores in the ShelfAtlas catalog. Filter by chain slug, or pass lat/lng for a nearest-first geo search (optionally capped by radius_km; geo results are not paginated).

tools.name: search_catalog_offers
tools.description: Search catalog offers (promotions and listed products) from Danish retail chains. Returns ONLY currently-valid offers unless include_expired is set. Filter by chain slug, product id, or EAN. Offers carry chainId — resolve names via list_chains. Self-serve keys see published campaign offers (tilbudsa

tools.name: find_cheapest_offers
tools.description: Answer 'where is this product cheapest right now?' in one call: the currently-valid offers for one product (by EAN or product id), cheapest first, with chain slug and name resolved. Combine with get_stores(lat/lng, chain_slug) to find the nearest store carrying the winning chain's offer. Self-serve

tools.name: get_product_by_ean
tools.description: Look up a product in the ShelfAtlas catalog by its EAN barcode.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Resolve a product NAME to its ShelfAtlas id and EAN — use this BEFORE calling find_cheapest_offers or search_catalog_offers when you only have a product name (e.g. from a user question) and not an id or barcode. Matches on the canonical product name, case-insensitive, substring match. Returns id, na

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_products" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
